definitions.explanation: A person who actively dislikes and criticizes a particular celebrity, content creator, team, or thing. Someone who goes out of their way to express negativity.

examples.japanese: アンチのコメントは{気|き}にしないようにしている。
examples.english: I try not to pay attention to comments from haters.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}になるとアンチも{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: As you become famous, haters also increase.

examples.japanese: アンチが{多|おお}いということは{注目|ちゅうもく}されている{証拠|しょうこ}だ。
examples.english: Having many haters is proof that you're getting attention.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English "anti" (against). In Japanese, アンチ has narrowed to specifically mean "hater" or "anti-fan."

REGISTER: Casual
Common in online communities, entertainment contexts, and general conversation about public figures.

USAGE NOTES:
・アンチ can be used as a prefix: アンチ{巨人|きょじん} (Giants hater - baseball)
・アンチ{活動|かつどう} refers to organized hate campaigns
・The opposite is ファン (fan) or {信者|しんじゃ} (devoted follower - sometimes pejorative)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・アンチコメント (hate comment)
・アンチが{沸|わ}く (haters appear - slang)
・アンチを{相手|あいて}にしない (to not engage with haters)
・アンチ{活動|かつどう} (anti-fan activities)

CONTRAST:
・アンチ: hater, anti-fan
・ファン: fan, supporter
・{信者|しんじゃ}: devoted follower (can be pejorative)
